test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 23 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Six letters, G, H, I, J, K and L are written on different faces of a dice. Three positions of this dice are shown here. Find the letter on the face opposite L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fcbe1b2f015d19f3266d53b52916b2412259b8200982769a96111d8d1c9a67b9.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given three different dices the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As L is common on both the dices II and III, it is clear that H, K, J, and G are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. I will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/711507ac2ff9664a4a5515cc3b6f64d93d89b25cb1dd399d39a126db6ff75b16.png] 

Opposite pairs:

H → G

K → J

L → I

So, the opposite side of "L" will be side "I".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
